about_the_game:
THE STORY

On your first day as an apprentice at the Nytheris Archive, you accidentally unleash an ancient force that was meant to stay sealed forever. Ooops!

Now, with the world teetering on the brink, it's up to you to piece together the remnants of a shattered relic and set things right.

Explore a world filled with strange characters, forgotten ruins, and puzzles. Follow the clues. Trust your instincts... and try not to make things worse.

Broken Relic invites you to navigate a crumbling world, uncovering its secrets one strange step at a time. You may not be the hero it needs. But you're what it’s got.

In this demo you can experience the first act of the game as it will be in the final game!

What to expect in this demo:

  • Complete Act 1 of the final game!

  • Fully voiced english dialogue. (The full version will be translated to more languages)

  • A handcrafted pixel art world filled with details and secrets.

  • No fail states, no pixel hunting, no filler.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS High Sierra and above
  • Processor: AMD FX-4300 (4 * 3800) or equivalent / Intel Core i3-3240 (2 * 3400) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM) or equivalent / GeForce GT 640 (2048 VRAM) or equivalent
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Big Sur
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM) or equivalent / GeForce GT 640 (2048 VRAM) or equivalent
